credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe and Orville Cox, a rare Adams portrait of one of the most famous images of O'Keeffe smiling. O'Keeffe is wrapped in a black cape (or blanket) wearing her black gaucho hat with her face turned slightly towards Orville Cox who is looking down, wearing a big black cowboy hat and denim jacket; sky and clouds behind them.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Orville Cox, Canyon de Chelly National Monument
